verdict.rationale: Fern's changelog says Fern Agent can now run on a schedule. These automations review reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, or analytics, report findings, and open pull requests when the prompt asks for a change. This is genuine recurring-workflow support, but only for Fern Agent tasks on a docs site, and it is evidenced only by changelog entries. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on schedule configuration (frequency/cron options, management, run history), scheduling of general-purpose jobs beyond Fern Agent prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
